## Task 1 · Which kind of storytelling? (2 marks)

Write **linear**, **branching** or **environmental** for each game.

a) In every play, the hero meets the same five levels in the same order and
sees the same ending.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The player finds an old diary and a broken window in an empty house, and
understands what happened there.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) The player decides to help the thief or to call the guard, and the game
has two different endings.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

d) Choose one game from a), b) or c). Write one effect that its kind of
storytelling has on the player.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · The story map of The Beekeeper (2 marks)

In a mobile game, Hana, an old beekeeper, finds that her bees have flown
away after a storm. First she chooses: **follow the bees into the forest**
or **ask her neighbour for help**. Both paths meet at the **old oak tree**,
where the queen bee hides. There she chooses again: **take the queen home**
or **build a new hive at the oak**. Each choice gives its own ending.

a) Which scene is the bottleneck? How many endings does the story have?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Write one thing at the old oak that shows the first choice, so that it
is not a fake choice. Write one object in Hana's garden that tells what the
storm did. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
